tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// nor lha spyi gtor dgos 'dod char 'beb ces bya ba/

'di yongs rdzogs 'don pa rgyas pa'o// bstod bshags bsdus pa yan 'don pa 'bring po 'o// de las mngon rtogs skyur na bsdus pa'o// na mo ārya dzaṃ bha la ye/ nor lha spyi gtor ni gtor ma rin po che'i dbyibs can dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa bshams/ ma 'dzom tshe rnam sras ser chen gyi gtor ma la bsngo rung ngo*// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ rin chen lnga las grub pa yi// gzhal med khang dbus pad zla'i steng*// dzam lha sku mdog dkar po ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas be con// phyag g.yon ne'u le bsnams pa ste// gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga ldan pa// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes// spyan gsum zhal gdangs rin chen gyi// rgyan ldan 'brug la 'chib pa 'o// shar du rdo rje ḍākki ma// mthing nag g.yas na rdo rje dang*// g.yon pas rten 'brel nor rdzas 'dzin// lho ru rin chen ḍākki ma// ser mo g.yas na nor bu dang*// g.yon pas rin chen bum pa 'dzin// nub tu padma ḍākki ma// dmar mo g.yas na padma dang*// g.yon pas 'gugs byed lcags kyu 'dzin// byang du las kyi ḍākki ma// ljang gu rdo rje rgya gram g.yas// g.yon pas ne'u le'i rkyal bum 'dzin// kun kyang rin chen rgyan ldan zhing*// phyed bskum tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur// pho brang de yi phyi khyams su// phyogs mtshams padma'i gdan brgyad la// lte ba 'dab mar zla gdan re// shar dbus dzam las dzam dmar ni// dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal gsum pa// phyag drug dang pos rin chen thod// bar pas lcags kyu zhags pa ste// tha gnyis ne'u le rin chen 'beb// zhabs bzhis nor bdag pho mo mnan// de yi phyogs mtshams 'dab ma la// dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang nag /khra bo zhal gsum phyag drug ste// byang shar 'dab mar dzam lha dgu /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis te// re re 'ang 'khor ni brgyad res bskor// lho dbus hūm̐ las dzam nag ni// rab khros thod khrag ne'u le 'dzin// phyogs mtshams sde brgyad dzam nag brgyad// rgyan ldan rin chen ne'u le 'o// nub dbus dzam las dzam lha dang*// ku bai rā sogs gnod sbyin brgyad// ser po bi dza ne'u le 'dzin// de yi g.yon dbus phyogs mtshams su// nor rgyun ma sogs lha mo brgyad// mchog sbyin 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// byang dbus dzaṃ las dzam lha ser// zhal gsum phyag drug dkyil krung bzhugs// g.yas gsum shing thog lcags kyu mda'// g.yon gsum zhags pa ne'u le gzhu// rang 'dra'i yum gyis g.yon nas 'khyud// de yi 'dab brgyad phyi nang la// 'phags pa ngal gso rigs bcu bzhi// 'brog gnas mched lnga'i 'khor gyis bskor// shar lhor a par tsitta dkar// 'jigs gzugs nor bu ne'u le bsnams// phag gdong ser mo gri thod 'dzin// mched lnga gar stabs mu tig brgyan// lho nub nor bdag ye shes grags// dmar mdzes rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// kun 'khyil mched gsum mthing nag dmar// bzhengs thabs bum pa nor bu 'dzin// nub byang gang po mdzes ma gnyis// ser mdzes shing thog bum pa 'bul// byang shar shrī las lha mo dpal// ljang mdzes rin chen padma dang*// skyabs sbyin mdzad cing bum steng bzhugs// gser mdog bu mo lnga brgyas bskor// phyi rol 'khor yug chen po la// gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu gnyis ni// bye ba drug cu drug cur bcas// lcang lo can nas spyan drangs gyur// hūm̐/

byang phyogs gter gyi gzhal yas nas// nor gyi dbang phyug dzaṃ bha la// thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzam lha'i rigs dang rnam sras rigs// nor lha pho dgu mo dgu dang*// a par tsitta lha mo dpal// gang mdzes nor bdag ye shes grags// phag gi gdong ser mched lnga dang*// zas gos nor gyi lha mo gsum// 'brog gnas mched lnga la sogs pa// gnod sbyin nor lha thams cad byon// ji srid bar du brtan par bzhugs// badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ tiṣṭha lhan/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag gi /dpal 'byor blo yis blangs te 'bul// yid sprul rtag brgyad rin chen bdun// dngos 'byor mchod gtor 'di 'bul bzhes// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ padma kro dha ārya dzaṃ bha la hri da ya hūm̐/ i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ye dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā i daṃ= oṃ dzaṃ luṃ swā hā i daṃ= oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ye swā hā i daṃ= oṃ āḥhūm̐ buddha badzra ratna padma karma dzaṃ bha la siddhi pha la hūm̐ i daṃ= oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā i daṃ= oṃ pūrṇa bha drā ya swā hā i daṃ= oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā i daṃ= oṃ ku bai rā ya swā hā i daṃ= oṃ ki li mā li ne swā hā i daṃ= oṃ pi tsi kuṇḍa li ne swā hā i daṃ= oṃ mu khen drā ya swā hā i daṃ= oṃ tsa ryand+rā ya swā hā i daṃ= oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇyai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ tsand+rā kāenta yai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ datta yai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ su dadata yai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ ārya yai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ su bha drā yai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ guptā yai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ sa ra swa tyai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ de wi shrī yai swā hā i daṃ= oṃ bai shra wa ṇa a yu ṣe hūm̐ a i daṃ= oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ye swā hā i daṃ= oṃ ma hā rā dzā yaksha sa ma ya bai shra ma ṇa ye sarba tsitta ratna hrīṃ hrī dza dzaḥ.i daṃ=

oṃ nā ga nī bha su te sū tra padma swā hā i daṃ= oṃ bhyo takṣa bhyoḥ.i daṃ= oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ye na da ku bai rā ma hāḥ bha ga bai tri ta bi na te na ma siddhi swā hā i daṃ= oṃ bha su bha drā/ pūrṇa bha drā/ sa bhu ta dzhaṃ na/ kanta ri stha ta/ bha wa ṣo ni ra swā hā i daṃ= oṃ ma hā kā la gu na hri da hūm̐/ dhe wa bha ti hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ= ma hā kā la dhi dha hi lu sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ ranta siddhi hoḥ.i daṃ= oṃ hrīḥ.a pa ra tsitta dza dzaḥ.i daṃ= oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra yakṣa dha ri ni i daṃ= oṃ dhe wa nā ga yaksha shu la ma ma bhi bhu ya ma du tri dzaṃ bha la ye swā hā i daṃ= tri 'u tri 'u i daṃ= oṃ i ling ki /pi ling ki /ki ling ki /a na le/ kun dha le/ ghrihna piṇḍa li/ pi shā tsi na ye/ na mo shu tra mu tri ma hā pi shā tsi na ye swā hāḥ.i daṃ= oṃ sarba yakṣa yakṣi i daṃ= oṃ sarba ba su de wa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabda pra titstsha ye swā hā/ 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po 'brug zhon lha lnga/ dzam dmar nor skyug pho mo/ khro zhing sgeg pa'i dzaṃ bha la/ dzam ser zhal gsum phyag drug yab yum/ dzam ser nor rgyun ma yab yum/ dzam bha la rigs dgu rigs thams cad pa/ rnam sras rigs dgu rigs thams cad pa/ nor lha pho brgyad mo brgyad/ lha mo chen mo dpal/ gnod sbyin a pa ra tsitta/ gnod sbyin gang po dang mdzes ma/ nor bdag ye shes grags/ gnod sbyin phag dong ma mched lnga/ kun 'khyil ma spun gsum/ 'brog gnas mched lnga/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis/ sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis/ ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug /yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya/ gnod sbyin bu mo yid 'phrog nor bu ma lnga brgya/ klu mo padma'i gtsug phud ma la sogs 'phags pa gnas srung gi btsun mo lnga brgya/ kun tu rgyal ba la sogs sras lnga brgya/

sras mo lnga brgya/ 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu drug cu'i tshogs rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// mnyes shing tshims nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ stobs dang mnga' thang*/ nor dang longs spyod thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bkre skom mu ge lo nyes phyugs nad god kha snying stong thams cad zhi ba dang zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /hūm̐/ bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// gzugs kyi skur bstan dzaṃ bha la// dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs sel// dzam lha 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// thog med ser sna'i las bsags rnams// mthol bshags byang zhing dag gyur cig /dbul phongs thams cad zhi ba dang*// dpal 'byor nor dbyig 'phel zhing rgyas// 'dod rgu'i snang srid dbang du sdus// snyigs dus mu ge'i bskal pa zlogs// thugs dam dus bab sa ma ya// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// bsdu na de yan gyis chog la/ ༈ rgyas par byed na 'di sbyar ro// hūm̐/ mchod yon bsil zer khengs pa'i ga pur te/ khrus chab sbrul gyi snying po'i rdzas ldan rdzing*// me tog 'ja' mdangs so sor phon byas pa// bdug spos yongs 'du'i drung nas 'thul ba'i ngad// mar me nyin mor byed pa'i gzugs gsar pa// byug pa yid 'ong lha yi chu bo'i rgyun// zhal zas bdud rtsi'i rtser thon ro brgya pa// rol mo yan lag 'bum ldan snyan pa'i sgra /re re'ang mchod pa'i yo byad ma lus pas// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams kun bkang zhing// thams cad tshogs kyang dog pa ma mchis pa'i// ngo mtshar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin 'bul lo// hūm̐/ brtan g.yo bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dkyil chen por// klu dbang rin chen thams cad legs par bstar// mtho ris 'byor pa lhun du chags pa'i rtser// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi zlos gar sgyur// gter bum ma rmos snye ma brdal ba'i sar// mtha' bzhi rnam gnon rgyal srid sna bdun bshams// dpag bsam nags su 'dod 'jo ba yi khyu// phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i phyir// bsam 'phel mthu stobs rngam brjid 'gying ba dang*// gzhan yang srid zhi'i tshar du dngar ba yi// dbang phyug chen po'i longs spyod ma lus pa// mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod du 'bul gyis bzhes//

zhes mchod pa rgya chen yid kyis sprul te mchod nas/ jo bo rjes zhal gzigs dus bstod pa'i rgya gzhung byin rlabs can ni/ e ma ho/ 'jig rten dbang phyug nor bdag skur sprul 'phags pa ni// gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra gyen brdzes nor bu'i brgyan// sha rgyas gsus 'phyang sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas bklubs// phyag g.yas be con 'dzin pas 'jig rten dbang du sdud// g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin pas longs spyod char bzhin 'beb// sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags 'brug la 'chib// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yon gyi gru mor rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ bsnams pa ni// nyid kyi sku la gnyis med 'khril ba'i yum mchog mtshon// spyan gsum khro gnyer cung zad bsdus pa zhi khro'i tshul// yid la re ba'i 'bras bu sbyin la phyag 'tshal bstod// shar du zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas rten 'brel nor rdzas 'dzin// bgegs rigs kun 'joms rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// lho ru ser sna rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku /rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas nor bu g.yon pas rin chen bum pa 'dzin// dbyig gi char 'beb rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// nub tu 'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog ye shes sku /padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas padma g.yon pas 'gugs byed lcags kyu bsnams// 'gro rnams dbang sdud padma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// byang du phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku /las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas ne'u le'i rkyal bum bsnams// las kun 'grub byed sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po nam mkha'i mdog can nor gyi char 'beb pa// ma skyes rang bzhin dag phyir sku mdog sngon por bzhugs/

khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid do bdag dran na// rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu'i tshim par mdzod/ ༈ /bde gshegs kun gyi gsung las legs sprul zhing*// thugs rje chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs// dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzaṃ bha la// ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas zhal dkar bas lha rnams dbang du sdud// g.yon zhal sngo bas klu rnams dbang du sdud// rtsa zhal dmar bas mi rnams dbang du sdud// srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhis nor skyug mnan// 'gro kun re skong yid bzhin rin chen dang*/ khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu gnyis// g.yas kyi dang po bar pas bsnams par mdzad// rin chen thod pa zhags pa g.yon gnyis na// tha gnyis ne'u le btsir zhing rin chen 'beb// rnam mang rin chen nor gyi char 'beb pas// ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal bstod// sku la rin chen du mas rnam par brgyan// klu chen brgyad dang lha yi na bzas bklubs// sgeg pa'i nyams ldan 'gro ba kun yid sdud// mgon po dzaṃ bha la la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag la longs spyod nor chen dngos grub stsol// ces grwa pa mngon shes can gyis gter ma'o// nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzaṃ bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ ngal gso dge ba stobs chen lus ngan po// g.yu mdog go dang rgyan cha dar gyis bklubs// rgyal mtshan ne'u le 'dzin cing seng ge'i khar// phyed skyil brjid chags gnod sbyin mthu bo che// btsun mo nang blon mngag gzhug sder bcas pa// mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod la longs spyod phyir/ khyod la 'dud kyis dpag bsam yongs 'du bzhin// bsam pa'i re ba gang ba'i mchog sbyin mdzod// hūm̐/

baṃ las gyur pa'i gnod sbyin mo// gser gyi mdog 'dra g.yas gri gug /g.yon pas thod khrag legs bsnams shing*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga la rab tu 'khyud// phag gi gdong can mu tig brgyan// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// rang 'dra'i 'khor bzhi bcas la bstod// mchod pas mnyes nas 'dod pa'i don// char rgyun bzhin du ster bar mdzod// 'ja' tshon pa'i gter ma 'o// dur khrod nags tshal shing drung chen po ru// lhag par gnas bcas sha za mkha' 'gro gsum// sgyu ma'i skur ston phrin las sgrub pa'i lha// sna tshogs 'dzad med yid bzhin nor 'dra zhing*// dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba skong*// mi 'dzad gter gyi bum bzang mdzod 'dzin pa// dgos 'dod mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// sha za mkha' 'gro mched gsum gyis// gtor ma bzhes la bdag gzhan kun// byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs kyi phyir// sbyin dang bsam pa tshogs kyi rdzas// sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dngos grub stsol// klu sgrub kyis mdzad sna tshogs rang grol gter ma'o// hūm̐/ gnod gnas dbang po ārya dzaṃ bha la// dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis sogs// cha lugs sna tshogs phyag mtshan sna tshogs can// sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dzam lha'i yab gyur sems dpa' rin chen mang*// dkar po lcags kyu bum bsnams seng ge 'chib// sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug klu mo 'khril// nag po dor stabs mchod rten ba dan phyar// dmar nag ral gri mda' dar rta sngon can// dmar po zangs ral phub bsnams rta sngon 'chib// skag mdog bzhengs stabs mdung dmar mchod rten bsnams// dmar mdzes bzhengs stabs phyag gnyis dung sgra sgrog /sngo ljang ral gri ne'u le rta sngon 'chib// ri rab phyogs mdog bzhengs stabs bzhugs pa sogs// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i lus can khyod la bstod// dzam lha'i mes po drang srong rnam mang thos// dzam lha'i phyi mo lha mo dpal chen mo// dpal ldan ma dang dkar mo bkra shis ma// padma'i phreng ba can dang padma'i spyan// nor gyi bdag mo grags pa chen mo dang*// rin chen rab sbyin ma dang zas sbyin ma// byed pa mo dang 'od zer chen mo ste// bcu gnyis mtshan ldan ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dzam lha'i yum ni padma gtsugs bde ma// dmar ser nor bu pad snod zhal zas bsnams// btsun mo lnga brgya gnod sbyin bu mo ni// yid 'phrog lnga brgya'i tshogs dang bcas la bstod// dzam lha'i mched kyi mchog gyur gar mkhan mchog

/mdog smug g.yu 'brug la 'chib bco brgyad phyag /kun tu rgyal ba la sogs lnga brgyar bcas// smug 'dzin mched lcam la sogs bstod par bgyi// dzam lha'i btsun mo lha mo nor rgyun ma// zla 'od ma dang shin tu bzang mo dang*// chu shel ma dang 'phags ma sbas ma dang*// so legs ma dang lha mo dbyangs can ma// nor lha mo dgu 'khor dang bcas la bstod// dzam lha'i bka' blon nor srung chen po brgyad// nor bu bzang po gang ba bzang po dang*// ku bai rā dang gnod sbyin dmar po dang*// ki li mā li pi tsi kuṇḍa lī// mu khen drā dang tsa ryan drā la bstod// dzam lha'i bka' sdod 'jig rten longs spyod bdag /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dzaṃ bha la// gshin rje btsan dang ma mo dzaṃ bha la// bdud dang drang srong nyi zla'i dzaṃ bha la// phyugs lha ljang gur bcas la mchod cing bstod// nor bu bzang po dung mdog lug gi gdong*// gang ba bzang po gser mdog rta yi gdong*// srid spangs zangs mdog ra yi gdongs pa can// rgyal ba khyu mchog g.yu mdog glang chen dbu// yang dag shes ni mthing mdog sha ba'i gdong*// 'brog gnas mched lnga 'khor bcas mchod cing bstod// a par tsitta bang mdzod gnyer kha ba// gang po mdzes ma mngag gzhug khol po ste// myur mgyogs pho nya nor bdag ye shes grags// dzam lha'i 'khor g.yog bran dang bcas la bstod// gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu gnyis nyi shu brgyad// ljongs gnas bcu drug stobs chen sum cu gnyis// yul skyong lnga brgya gnod sbyin 'khor gyi tshogs// bye ba drug cu drug cu tshogs dang bcas// sde bo che la dpung che drag shul che/ kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang gzi brjid che// gzhan gyis mi thub pha rol dpung 'joms pa// 'phags pa gnod gnas dbang po 'khor bcas la// mchod do bstod do mchod bstod byin rlabs kyis// bdag cag dpon slob srung bya 'khor bcas la// phyugs nad god kha thams cad zlog tu gsol// skal ngan mu ge thams cad zlog tu gsol// phya g.yang bsod nams nyams pa zlog tu gsol// dbang thang rlung rta rgud pa zlog tu gsol// gtor brlag tshong nyes snying stong zlog tu gsol// bse rag ltog 'gong dbul sri zlog tu gsol// rta nad rtil sri thams cad zlog tu gsol// lug nad tal 'brum thams cad zlog tu gsol// rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bang mdzod 'bru yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// ja dar longs spyod dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gser dngul rin chen dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rta drel bzhon pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// lhab lhub gos kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rgyud 'dzin mi yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// mnga' ris 'khor 'bangs rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/

khas drag stobs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'dzad med gter gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'di nas gzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod la longs spyod nas// 'phags pa mchod dang dbul phongs skyob byed cing*// sbyin pa'i phar phyin myur du rdzogs pa yi// phrin las mdzad cing sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

dzaṃ bha la'i rgyud gnod gnas dbang po'i rtogs brjod las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bkal bstsal pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma gsag pa'i rna ba'i khung bur thos shing grags par mi 'gyur/ gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba ma gsag pa'i sems can rnams kyis nyan pa dang*/ 'bri ba dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ klog pa tsam yang nus par mi 'gyur/ sems can gang gis snying po 'di 'dzin pa dang rjes su gzung bar 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro// bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro// ngan 'gror skye bar mi 'gyur ro// mthong ba tsam gyis nad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// dbul po dang*/ yid mi bde ba dang*/ lus kyi zug rngu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro// mkhas pa thams cad kyis mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur// lha thams cad dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin rnams 'dus pas kyang sngags 'di 'dzin pa'i yon tan dang phan yon rtogs par mi nus so// zhes dang*/ gnod gnas rgyal bar brjod pa las/ mdor na 'di las gzhan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan med/ 'di 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i gnas yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rtag tu byin gyis brlabs pa'o// pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs dang sa thob par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// dzam dkar sgrub thabs rje dkon mchog yan lag gi mdzad pa dang*/ dzam dmar grwa pa mngon shes can gyis gter ma gnyis gtso bor byas/ rdo rje phreng ba/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs bka' gsar rnying thams cad kyi don bsdus te/ lo nyes dang phyugs nad chen pos mu ge'i bskal pa dar la nye ba'i tshe/ dge slong bsod snyoms pa rā ga a syas bris pa la nyes pa gang mchis bshags shing dge bas sems can thams cad mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod la spyod par gyur cig
